title: This Crab Rips Its Sea Anemone in Half to Make a Clone

scenes.text: This crab clones its own boxing gloves.
Pom-pom crabs are coin-sized, and each claw holds a live stinging sea anemone.
They wave the anemones at fish to scare them off.
Scientists removed one anemone. The crab ripped the other one in half.
Both halves regrew into full anemones within days.
A crab with none will steal one from another crab and do the same.

description:
This crab clones its own boxing gloves.
In a 2017 study, Red Sea pom-pom crabs split a sea anemone in two and both halves grew back.
What animal tool is the coolest you know?
first_comment: Would you rather have stinging gloves or a clone factory in your hands?
